comments.text:
Such a well crafted documentary! The visuals of Sardinia’s coastline and ancient towns are absolutely stunning. 🌊✨
It's fascinating how many centenarians live here. Everyone credits the Mediterranean diet, but do you think the key to their longevity is really the food, or is it the stress-free lifestyle and tight-knit community? Curious to hear what others think!
